name: Polybound
summary:
Welcome to Polybound, a new, creative experience where you can express yourself in however way you want. Share maps, take photos, talk with others, make friends, there's no limit to what you can create!

Explore a vast amount of User-generated maps people have made and shared with the community, with tons of variety on what you can play. Adjust your character to match your personality, or to whatever you think is right for you!
